definition: Overwhelmed by a sense of complete emotional destruction.
author: Ann Ward Radcliffe
quote: On perceiving this beloved idea to be an illusion of her own creation, Valancourt seemed to be annihilated, and her soul sickened at the blank, that remained.
example_sentence: We were annihilated in the pub quiz by a team of teachers.
